SENIORS.—100 yards: 2nd, M.

Mike Broadbent and Gordon Lowers were first two home in the 100 yards, while Jim Beaumont and Heathfield were second and third in the 440. John Cope won the 880 yards with Archie Bedford third and Len Marchant won the mile with Len Adams third.

Derrick Burfitt did best for the club by gaining third place in the mile and as this race was won in the fast time of 4 mins. 15 secs., he can be said to have done very well. The placings of our members were as follows:—100 yards: 4th, M. Broadbent, after qualifying as fastest loser. 1 mile Junior: 5th, M.

At Dorking on July 2nd in a four-cornered match, Mike Broadbent completed a double by winning the 100 and 220 yards. Derrick Burfitt only just lost a fast half in 1 min. 59 secs., Len Marchant won the mile in 4 mins. 29 secs., and Len Herbert the 2 miles in 9 mins. 47 secs.

On Friday evening Michael Broadbent competed in Heat 1 of the 100 yards and was beaten by Mac Bailey in the fast time of 9.9 secs. He qualified to run in the second round on Saturday afternoon but was 5th in a 10.2 secs. heat!
